mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an interior decorator and an interior designer for finish upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior decorator typically focuses on the aesthetic aspects, such as paint colors, furniture, and accessories, to enhance the visual appeal of a space. An interior designer, on the other hand, has a broader scope, often involved in structural changes, space planning, and ensuring functional and safe environments, in addition to aesthetics. For significant finish upgrades, an interior designer may be more suitable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decorators focus on aesthetics; designers handle aesthetics plus structural changes and space planning for function and safety. Designers are better for significant upgrades.
